concept: Supporting a friend through a hard time without trying to fix or minimize what they're feeling
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student's friend is going through something difficult and the natural instinct is to jump in with advice or minimize the problem
exercise.branching_choice: Student chooses how to respond — offering advice, minimizing, or simply listening and validating
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on the difference between fixing and being present

assessment.success_marker: student can articulate why simply being present sometimes matters more than solving the problem
